name: Lyrics captions
description: Lyrics as a music app shows them: the line being sung big in the middle, the ones before and after small and dim around it, the view scrolling as the song moves on and the sung words brightening. Give a transcript with --words.

text.label: Text
text.description: what is said; leave empty to caption the transcript as it is. Wrap a word in *stars* for the accent
text.default: Every line you sing scrolls up into view, the one you sing now right in the middle.

accents.label: Accent words
accents.description: words to put in the accent wherever they are said, comma separated

parts.words: the caption words and everything drawn with them
